name: Denominator identification/resolution rule
concept: Treat epsilon as unresolved below an academically approved minimum abs(delta_P).
justification_required: Measurement/resolution or other defensible identification criterion; no natural plateau established
limitations: Dollar-cent resolution alone does not select a unique relative cutoff; exclusion can change mean

name: Approved robust/truncated support
concept: Calculate epsilon then restrict analysis/simulation support using an explicitly approved robust rule.
changes: Population used for mean/SD and possibly simulation support
justification_required: Principled scope and rule independent of merely passing SD<4
limitations: Tail removal changes estimand/population; analysis and simulation scopes need distinction

name: Scenario-level relationship estimator
concept: Estimate relative-price/relative-distance relationship at scenario level rather than averaging individual ratios.
changes: Material change to estimator and potentially interpretation
justification_required: Explicit methodology approval of estimator, direction and assumptions before implementation
limitations: Avoids observation-wise division but does not automatically identify causal elasticity or guarantee SD<4 comparability
